text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Looking back on Seeking the Pearl's footprints.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning the Hanshin JF, the Oka Sho, and the NHK Mile Cup. Everything up to this point went as planned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before developing roaring, Seeking the Pearl
was an unbeatable Umamusume in the mile.
However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, reporter over there!
Could you not steal my lines?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's simply wonderful!
Even after the NHK Mile Cup..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
After winning the Mile Championship, Victoria Mile,
and Yasuda Kinen, and furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Back-to-back Mile CS wins!
To win so many Mile GⅠs!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Well, it's more like... by the time I realized it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Um! I doubt it's the case, but...
Well... about that roaring issue...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
It can't be fake news, right?
Or maybe she's completely recovered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course it isn't. This handicap
is a badge of honor that made me stronger. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I understand... I know very well why I was able to keep winning in mile races, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't even explain it clearly to myself.
Yet Seeking the Pearl seemed
to have realized it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand.
The reason being—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because I've become god-tier strong—
enough to laugh off any handicap!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Yes, right now I am a pearl far too radiant! Minor blemishes don't even matter anymore. Ohohoho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I understood.
Yes, Seeking the Pearl is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She overcame the handicap through sheer caliber.
So much so that she completely covered the gap.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And having achieved so much,
it's only right that there should be a fitting reward... a treat for you."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there is something I would like you to prepare.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Yes, this is it, this right here!
My very own relaxation room♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
An ordinary break room just won't cut it.
I must relax in the most supremely gorgeous way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inside the specially prepared room,
Seeking the Pearl was in high spirits."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A room of this caliber, naturally,
comes fully equipped with air conditioning..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, what is this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Borrowed it? Wait, could this be...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An electric fan! Going old-school with a cooling fan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Still, on the contrary, that might actually be fabulous. We'll be able to do *that*, too."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Yes, it's a legendary, one-hit comedy gag. You stand in front of an electric fan and laugh..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bwah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I amuse myself by reenacting a classic alien laugh.
Since it's a private room, I can do whatever I want.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this room is very good.
Or rather, if we could stay in a room like this
overseas...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It might just come true.
Another miracle, that is.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, conquering an overseas *mile* G1.
And in an exceptionally prestigious race, at that.”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A different G1 from the Prix Jacques Le Marois
that Taiki won. A race I'm not supposed
to be able to win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I might just be able to win there, too.
Yielding to neither deep turf nor rain.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "It's nice, isn't it? Imagining how the future will change like this..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I now possess the strength to change everything.
And it's all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, it would be nonsense to talk too much.
Let's have a toast.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's an advance celebration. We'll enjoy a glamorous time while envisioning our future glory♪ Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We toast with sparkling juice.
Straining my ears—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I heard it faintly. The gentle murmur of the Seine, and the roaring cheers destined to echo in the future.
